description: This module creates, removes, or updates Keycloak users.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: email_verified
parameters.description: Check the validity of user email. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: federated_identities
parameters.description: List of IDPs of user. Default: []

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, allows to remove user and recreate it. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: List of groups for the user. Groups can be referenced by their name, like staff, or their path, like /staff/engineering. The path syntax allows you to reference subgroups, which is not possible otherwise. Using the path is possible since community.general 10.6.0. Default: []

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user on the Keycloak server if known.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the realm in which is the client. Default: "master"

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Control whether the user should exists or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a user user1
  community.general.keycloak_user:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    username: user1
    firstName: user1
    lastName: user1
    email: user1
    enabled: true
    emailVerified: false
    credentials:
      - type: password
        value: password
        temporary: false
    attributes:
      - name: attr1
        values:
          - value1
        state: present
      - name: attr2
        values:
          - value2
        state: absent
    groups:
      - name: group1
        state: present
    state: present

- name: Re-create a User
  community.general.keycloak_user:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    username: user1
    firstName: user1
    lastName: user1
    email: user1
    enabled: true
    emailVerified: false
    credentials:
      - type: password
        value: password
        temporary: false
    attributes:
      - name: attr1
        values:
          - value1
        state: present
      - name: attr2
        values:
          - value2
        state: absent
    groups:
      - name: group1
        state: present
    state: present

- name: Re-create a User
  community.general.keycloak_user:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    username: user1
    firstName: user1
    lastName: user1
    email: user1
    enabled: true
    emailVerified: false
    credentials:
      - type: password
        value: password
        temporary: false
    attributes:
      - name: attr1
        values:
          - value1
        state: present
      - name: attr2
        values:
          - value2
        state: absent
    groups:
      - name: group1
        state: present
    state: present
    force: true

- name: Remove User
  community.general.keycloak_user:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    username: user1
    state: absent

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the user after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: existing
return_values.description: Representation of the existing user. Returned: on success

return_values.name: proposed
return_values.description: Representation of the proposed user. Returned: on success

return_values.name: user_created
return_values.description: Indicates whether a user was created. Returned: in success
